headlines.text: It was 2023 when Orange Cassidy vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Katsuyori Shibata vs. Zack Sabre Jr. went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 8.20 ? one of the better matches of the year. This stood as the 10th match in AEW International Title history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. It marked Orange Cassidy's 10th match with the title on the line. With no countouts or disqualifications, all four men traded submissions and suplexes before Cassidy stole the pin on Garcia with the Mouse Trap, his 25th straight successful International Title defense.

That Wednesday in 2026, the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Konosuke Takeshita vs. Ricochet went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.49 ? a match that delivered. This stood as the 60th match in AEW International Title history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title. In the final Dynamite before Forbidden Door, Takeshita survived Ricochet's full aerial arsenal ? including a 619 and a shooting star press ? before a Powerdrive Knee and Raging Fire retained the International Championship.
Turning the clock back to 2022: Andrade El Idolo vs. Rey Fenix met for the very first time, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 8.20 ? a genuinely great match.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2020, SCU (Daniels & Kaz) made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.17 ? a match that delivered.

Flash back to 2023, when the IWGP United States Title was up for grabs as Will Ospreay vs. Kenny Omega went to war, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 9.56 ? one of the greatest matches in company history. Ospreay avenged his Wrestle Kingdom loss in an all-time classic, trading Kawada kicks and near-falls with Omega before finally reclaiming the IWGP United States Championship.

Rewind to 2023, when Toni Storm vs. Willow Nightingale fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 5.65. It was the 40th time the AEW Women's World Title had been on the line, a real landmark for that championship.
